login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Your policies and claims stay private to you.
login.phoneHint: We'll send a 6-digit code on WhatsApp.
login.failed: That didn't work. Check the number or code and try again.
login.privacy: We only ask Google for your name, email and photo.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp number
whatsapp.why: Verify your number to get claim updates on WhatsApp. You can still add policies before this.
whatsapp.failed: Couldn't verify. Check the number or code and try again.

onboarding.title: A few details
onboarding.subtitle: This fills your claim letters, so you won't type it again.
onboarding.name: Your full name (as on the policy)
onboarding.tracks: What do you want to claim for?
onboarding.storageConsent: I agree to ClaimSathi storing my policy and claim documents
onboarding.storageHint: Needed to check documents. You can delete everything from Settings.
onboarding.callHint: Optional. Useful if you don't open the app daily.

errors.name: Enter your name
errors.storage_consent: We need this to check your documents

demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.subtitle: This is a demo. Sign in with one of these test accounts. Your changes stay in this browser only.
demo.pick: Tap an account to fill it in:
demo.failed: That email and password don't match a demo account.
demo.orOther: Or try the other sign-in options (they open a fresh account):

accounts.sunita: Sunita Devi: health claim (score 55, one overdue claim)
accounts.ramesh: Ramesh Kumar: crop claim (hail damage, 72-hour countdown)
accounts.judge: Judge: both tracks, plus the mock insurer console

email.resent: Sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).

password.rules: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Use your email to keep your policies and claims in one place.
signup.checkEmail: We've sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.
signup.checkEmailHint: No email after a few minutes? Check spam. If you already have an account with this email, sign in or reset your password instead.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with. We'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has a ClaimSathi account, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.sentHint: The link works once and expires after a short time. Check spam if you don't see it.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a password you haven't used here before.
reset.done: Your password is changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.requestNew: Send me a new reset link

session.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
session.restoreFailed: We couldn't restore your sign-in. Check your connection and sign in again.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Open the link we sent you.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Sign in, or reset your password.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too easy to guess. Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.
errors.samePassword: Your new password must be different from the old one.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.signupDisabled: New sign-ups are turned off for this project (Supabase → Authentication → Sign In / Providers → Allow new users to sign up).
errors.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't set up yet: add the Supabase URL and publishable key to frontend/.env.local.
errors.network: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailNotAuthorized: Supabase won't send email to this address yet. Its built-in email service only sends to members of the project's team: set up custom SMTP in Supabase (Authentication → Emails → SMTP settings), or sign up with a team member's email for testing.
errors.emailProviderDisabled: Email and password sign-in is turned off for this project. Turn on the Email provider in Supabase (Authentication → Sign In / Providers → Email).
errors.secretKeyInBrowser: The app is set up with a Supabase secret key, which browsers can't use. Put the publishable key (sb_publishable_…) in VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in frontend/.env.local, then restart the app.
errors.invalidApiKey: Supabase didn't accept the app's API key. Check VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY are from the same project, then restart the app.
errors.signupDatabaseError: Supabase couldn't save the new account in the database. Check the Auth logs in Supabase; a trigger on auth.users may be failing.
errors.serverUnavailable: Supabase isn't responding right now (the project may be paused or restarting). Try again in a minute.

fieldErrors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com
fieldErrors.passwordWeak: Use at least one letter and one number
